description: Read providers, MCP servers, prompts and skills from your local CCSwitch installation. Switching a provider here updates Cognia's bundled SDK and (optionally) propagates to selected external agents.

dialog.body: Review what the switch will change before confirming.
dialog.bodyFor: Switch to {name}. Review what changes before confirming.
dialog.noChange: Cognia-next's API key and base URL already match this provider — no sidecar restart needed.
dialog.subscriptionActivated: Anthropic subscription activated from your signed-in account.
dialog.subscriptionAdopted: Local Claude Code login adopted and activated as your Anthropic subscription.
dialog.subscriptionNoneFound: No Anthropic subscription found — sign in under Settings → Subscription, or run `claude login` and switch again.
dialog.title: Switch provider
dialog.useSubscription: Official provider — cognia will reuse your Anthropic subscription (existing signed-in account, or this machine's Claude Code login) instead of an API key.
dialog.willRestart: The bundled SDK sidecar will be restarted so the new env takes effect.
dialog.willWrite: Will write to {count, plural, =1 {1 agent file} other {# agent files}}.

mcp.headerHint: Selected MCP servers are imported into Cognia's MCP store using the existing 'skip / overwrite / duplicate' semantics.

strategy.duplicateDesc: Add the import with a ' (imported)' suffix on the name.

mcp.strategyBody: When a server with the same name already exists in Cognia.

overview.activeBody: The provider whose API key + base URL match Cognia's current settings.
overview.detectedBody: Cognia will read this database read-only. CCSwitch remains the editor.
overview.driftBody: Cognia and at least one external agent disagree on the active provider. Pick one in the Providers tab to reconcile.
overview.noActiveBody: Cognia is using a manually-entered API key, or a provider whose key/URL don't match any CCSwitch record.
overview.notFoundBody: We couldn't find ~/.cc-switch/cc-switch.db. Install CCSwitch and add at least one provider, then come back.
overview.webModeBody: CCSwitch interop reads a local SQLite database. Run Cognia in desktop mode (`pnpm tauri dev`) to use this section.

prompts.headerHint: Each selected prompt becomes a new Cognia prompt preset (category 'custom').

providers.emptyBody: Add a provider in CCSwitch first.
providers.headerHint: CCSwitch is the editor for these records — go back to CCSwitch to add, rename or delete.
providers.quotaImportFailed: Couldn't save the imported quota source: {error}

quotaImportReason.invalid-endpoint: The quota endpoint is missing or invalid.
quotaImportReason.missing-credentials: The CCSwitch record does not contain the credential required by this quota endpoint.
quotaImportReason.missing-script: This provider does not include CCSwitch quota metadata.
quotaImportReason.unsupported-provider: This provider requires native signing or another unsupported authentication flow.
quotaImportReason.unsupported-template: Only recognized declarative CCSwitch quota templates can be imported; arbitrary JavaScript is never executed.

providers.quotaImportSuccess: Imported {name} as a disabled custom quota source. Review it under Subscription settings, then enable it explicitly.

skills.headerHint: Skills with inline content become new Cognia skills. Rows pointing at an external file (greyed) need to be re-imported via Settings → Skills.

sync.enabledBody: When off, the section is hidden from the sidebar and no IPC is issued.
sync.flagsBody: Master toggle and refresh behaviour for the CCSwitch section.
sync.manualDirBody: Override where cognia looks for cc-switch.db. Use this when your CCSwitch data folder lives somewhere we can't auto-detect (e.g. a synced drive).
sync.manualDirHint: Takes priority over CCSwitch's own redirect, but below the CC_SWITCH_HOME environment variable. Leave blank to auto-detect.
sync.propagationBody: These agents are pre-checked when you open the 'Use here & in…' dialog. Per-switch selection still wins.
sync.watchDbBody: Re-poll cc-switch.db whenever the Cognia window regains focus, so the active provider badge stays fresh.

title: CCSwitch
